_meta.notes: The candidate's name is typewritten on the cover; everything else is hand-filled. April 5 interim box checked, amendment = No, signed 4/5/06, clerk-stamped RECEIVED APR 13 2006 (faxed 'Apr 05 06 08:45a Russell Cannon'). The Summary Page header box (page/name/date) was left entirely blank. Lines 1 (both columns), 3, 4 and 5 are hand-drawn slashed zeros, recorded as '0'. Line 7 is a NEGATIVE balance written inside hand-drawn ANGLE brackets with a diagonal stroke across the cell; recorded as (153.20) in the conventional accounting-parenthesis form. The digits of Line 7 are more angular than lines 2 and 6, but 3x crops of all three cells show the same figure 153.20.
